# Hermes Agent FAQ & Onboarding Guide

### 1. Installation & Platforms
- **Native Windows**: Tier 1 supported via PowerShell (`install.ps1`). WSL2 is recommended only when using the Web Dashboard embedded terminal (`/chat`), which requires a POSIX PTY.
- **Docker & NAS**: The official image (`nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest`) provides multi-arch manifests (`linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64` for Raspberry Pi / Apple Silicon). For NAS permission errors on mapped volumes (UGOS Pro, Synology, unRAID), set `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) environment variables.
- **Android / Termux**: Supported via install script; detects Termux, sets temporary files to `$TMPDIR`, and installs the curated `[termux-all]` dependency bundle.
- **Web Interface**: Run `hermes dashboard` to launch the local web UI and browser chat at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`.

### 2. Model Providers & Configuration
- **Small Local Models (Ollama / Qwen 4B–9B) Slow**: Hermes sends ~45 tool schemas per turn. Disable unused tools with `hermes tools`, choose a faster quantization or 32B+ model, and set `terminal.backend: local` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`.
- **Local Endpoint Ignored**: When `provider: auto` detects remote API keys in the environment (e.g. `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`), it overrides local URLs. Set `provider: custom` and `base_url: http://localhost:11434` in `config.yaml`.
- **Custom Vision Models**: Set `supports_vision: true` in your custom model configuration block.
- **Claude Pro/Max vs API**: API keys are always billed per token by Anthropic. To use Pro/Max subscription allowances, authenticate via Claude OAuth.
- **Azure Foundry & Ollama Cloud**: For Azure AI Foundry, set `provider: azure-foundry` and export `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`. For Ollama Cloud, select `provider: ollama-cloud` (routes to `https://ollama.com/v1`).
- **Gemini Setup**: Legacy CLI OAuth is removed. Use Google AI Studio with `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
- **Model Routing**: Automatic complexity routing (`smart_model_routing`) is deliberately not supported. Switch models manually (`/model`, `hermes chat -m <model>`) or configure subagent models via `delegation.model`.

### 3. Messaging Gateways & Personas
- **Gateway Configuration**: Run `hermes gateway setup` for an interactive CLI wizard that securely stores platform tokens and permissions (Discord, Telegram, etc.).
- **Telegram "Unauthorized user"**: `allowed_chats` is only a group response filter. To authorize private DM interactions, add your numeric user ID to `telegram.allow_from` in `config.yaml`, or run `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`.
- **File & Media Transfers**: Gateways automatically ingest inbound attachments (`.txt`, `.py`). Outbound generated files and media are delivered natively (Matrix `m.file`, email SMTP attachments, DingTalk Markdown `![image](url)`, and MCP image outputs via `MEDIA:<path>`).
- **Personas & Profiles**: Set per-channel system prompts with `channel_prompts`. Run multiplexed gateway profiles to keep accounts, credentials, sessions, and memory isolated. Use `delegate_task` to coordinate subagents.

### 4. Memory, Execution & Autonomy
- **Memory Files**: `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` defines the agent persona/character; `USER.md` holds persistent user profile and preferences (`target="user"`); `MEMORY.md` stores long-term global facts.
- **Custom Memory & Tools**: In-tree additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed. Create external memory providers implementing `MemoryProvider` in `~/.hermes/plugins/`. Add personal tools as plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/` and enable via `hermes plugins enable <name>`.
- **Turn Limits & Autonomy**: `agent.max_turns` defaults to 90 (override with `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`). For long autonomous tasks, use `/goal <task>` (Ralph loop), which persists across turns and resumes with `/goal resume`.
- **Session Restores**: Crash-interrupted sessions enter `resume_pending`. Run `/resume` to restore conversation history. Idle resets default to `mode: none`.

### 5. Diagnostics & Observability
- **Diagnostics**: Run `hermes doctor` to verify dependencies, configuration, and auth providers.
- **Skill Usage**: View execution metrics via `/insights` or `hermes insights` (backed by `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json`).
- **Call Tracing**: Enable Langfuse tracing with `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse`.
- **Security Reports**: Report vulnerabilities privately via GitHub Security Advisories or email `security@nousresearch.com`.
